scope: Sixteen isolated actual RadioGrid/real option sets cases, including 390px operating-card inner width 278px. Original-column parity and central single-column mutation. Internal grid overflow is recorded separately and is not treated as resolved by page overflow checks. No profile state, hooks, authentication or persistence execute.
